issues.issue: Statement of Activities (p2-3) shows 652,540 of this as Airport capital grants and contributions, which are almost certainly FAA/state aeronautics money, plus 362,816 of economic development operating grants. Government grants belong in federal grants or intergovernmental/state aid, not donations/contributions. The source isn't stated, so this stays a judgment call. The same applies to detail lines for the Airport (detail[112]) and Economic Development (detail[123]) grants.

These are economic development loan repayments (collections of notes receivable), which are probably principal returning rather than revenue. No category fits; a person may want to decide how to treat them.

Airport operations have no specific category, so other is used with review. Defensible, but it is a judgment call; the matching detail line detail[115] (Operating expenditures 570,034) has the same issue.
The schedule doesn't break down airport charges, which may be mostly fuel sales rather than hangar rent. 'other charges for services' may fit better. The line is already flagged review.
